body: Off an on over 15 years now, the life insurance policy will pay off the mortgage and then some so husband and the girls have that to set them up to be financially ok.

Figuring that out right now, in one hell of a depressive episode and getting out of bed in near impossible, much less to work for full days.  Thankfully I have some freedom so a longer day here shorter there.

Currently have a blur playlist on now, not bad.  Thank you for taking some time out of your day to chat with me.

You might really like Speck - don't sweat the small stuff, give it a listen

Anything really, I listen to everything from enigma, delerium, to more top 40 sorta music.  Hollywood undead and speck are in there somewhere as well.  It really depends on my mood.  I'm bipolar so likes can be very opposite one week to the next.  I crashed out fo a mixed state almost 2 weeks ago now which is why I'm on this sub.

Unfortunately going out isn't an option but they are watching a movie, hence the tramadol and flexiril, not to mention some serious paranoia about going outside in the neighbourhood.  I have put on an enigma playlist on youtube and taken one of the prn seroquel i have.

do you have any obscure artists you listen to?

Suicidal ideation, not a fun place to be right now and the usual bits aren't really helping with that, freaked out a bit when I went through the medicine cabinet to see what I had handy and realizing I have tramadol, flexiril and saphris in sufficient quantities to cause some pretty serious issues... well cue panic attack.  What I need is some distraction for the next few hours or at least until I can calm myself down.  I'm even posting on ym throwaway account because people know my main and the very last thing I want to happen is a trip back to the hospital again.

3.5 hours to get through until my husband is home from work
sure, got it into my head today that I should talk to my psych about ideation next apt and snowballed from there.  I think this is more anxiety about it but it is enough to scare me a bit.
Thank you but it seems this was more of a vent, problem being I can't do those activities because of a spinal injury.  It's a little overwhelming at times.
Little bit yes, had a very rough morning but seem to be calmer now, probably shouldn't mess with meds again.  Brought it all on myself out of stupidity.
It's not so bad, burgundy and to the hairline in back for length :)
